item.title: STAFF POST OPEN- Crosslink Proposal
item.content:encoded:
The WikiWalk team is proposing edits to this page. All proposed edits will be in a collapsible below this post, and after 7 days if there are no serious objections to the edits, the feedback received will be taken into account as the edits are made. If you have questions not directly related to the article about this project, please pm a member of the WikiWalk Team.

Show Reasoning
Hide Reasoning

Proposing crosslinks to 2702 and 1002 due to the involvement of law enforcement type agencies.

Editing this:

The subject will then emerge from SCP-901 after a period of time consistent with observation.

To this:

The subject will then emerge from SCP-901 after a period of time consistent with observation.1

Footnotes
1. Of particular note are SCP-901's similarities to other law enforcement based SCP's, such as SCP-1002 and SCP-2701.

item.content:encoded: This SCP is nostalgic for me; it was one of the first I read. I love it even in spite of the expungement issues. Good work.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I was clicking links randomly throughout the list to find SCPs I had yet to read. I am quite pleased to have clicked on this one. Superbly creepy and inventive. It appealed to the overarching fear of totalitarianism while being flexible enough to affect the individuals on a directly personal level. I especially enjoyed the transcripts on Incident 901-01.

Good job.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I finally had another idea, I wanted to do something about 'totalitarianism' (it's a pretty common fear, but I don't think we have any SCPs which exploit it). I was a bit worried though as it was seeming like another 'evil building what makes you crazy'. Hopefully I've fleshed it out enough to avoid that.
